feature_policy: frozen manifest from prior champion; updated catalog mapping is output-only
target_semantics: At least one next-calendar-day SCADA security alarm with value 'Обнаружено движение' or 'Не замкнут'; proxy, not dispatcher-confirmed intrusion

balanced_threshold_selection.strategy: maximise minimum F1 across development windows
balanced_threshold_selection.tie_break: mean F1, pooled F1, then higher threshold

operational_threshold_selection.strategy: maximise minimum precision subject to per-window recall floor
operational_threshold_selection.tie_break: mean precision, minimum F1, then higher threshold

uncertainty.definition: weighted standard deviation of positively weighted component probabilities; higher means less model agreement

cat_base.category_handling_scope: raw strings seen by training rows only

integration_policy.selection_rule: maximize the worst absolute margin above precision 0.70 and recall 0.50 across both development years
